intro: Find train, U-Bahn, S-Bahn, tram and bus stops, taxi ranks, ferries and cable stations across Germany.

howTitle: Three steps to your next stop.
how2Text: Choose a transport type. Related station platforms and entrances are grouped into one stop.
how3Text: Check mapped access and platform details, then open walking directions. This finder does not show departure times.
dataLicense: Location data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Map tiles: OpenStreetMap. Icons: Lucide (ISC).

comfort: A little closer to your next stop.
openNowHint: Uses mapped hours. Places with missing or uncertain hours are excluded.
sourceHours: Community map details may be incomplete or outdated. Access hours describe the place, not departures or running services.
approximateTarget: Approximate mapped stop location. Check access and signs locally.

moreLines: More mapped lines are available in the source.
